correctness.rationale: PASS: Independently reconstructed the 10 tangent lines over Q(zeta5), their 45 pair intersections, 481 secants, and 61 qualifying lines. Exact cyclotomic arithmetic yielded 551 singular points with histogram 335 double, 140 triple, 70 fivefold, one tenfold, five twelvefold (pair count 1830). Verified Galois fixed totals 551,7,7,27 and degree counts 7+20+524. Independently enumerated all 35,990 line-triple determinants with 2,060 zero and 33,930 nonzero; exact 21-value norm frequency table matched the pinned verifier, giving prime support exactly {2,3,5,11,19}. Independently reconstructed reductions in GF(16),GF(81),GF(5),GF(11),GF(361), matching lines, geometric points, histograms and rational Frobenius counts at every exceptional prime; checked good primes 7,29,31. Thus the argument proves all good characteristics via complete determinant norm support, not finite sampling; Frobenius mod5 gives 551,27,7 for residue classes. Uniform primitive integral line vectors checked against prime-zero collisions.

value.rationale: A complete natural arithmetic bad-reduction classification for a previously studied complex 61-line arrangement distinguishes accidental merging at five primes and gives exact finite-field rational singular support and Galois degrees. Detecting and correcting the previously printed impossible five fifteenfold-point entry matters: it violates the line-pair count, whereas five twelvefold points satisfy it. The invariant is a model-specific but geometrically motivated arithmetic census; not a claim of all projectively equivalent integral presentations.
